repository.name: webex-node
repository.purpose: Node.js build of the Webex JS SDK. Loading the package installs @babel/polyfill when no polyfill is present, loads 17 Webex plugin packages for their registration side effects, and exports WebexNode, a WebexCore subclass with a static init factory that merges sdkType 'webex-node', the package configuration object, and the caller's config before constructing an instance. The package configuration in src/config.js is currently nested under config.default and not applied.

webex-node-sdk.summary: Published npm package webex-node. main and exports['.'] point at dist/index.js, exports['./package'] at package.json, and devMain at src/index.js. require('webex-node') returns the WebexNode class (CommonJS module.exports, no named exports). Loading it installs @babel/polyfill when global._babelPolyfill is not set and loads the 17 plugin packages listed in src/webex-node.js. WebexNode.init(attrs) merges {sdkType: 'webex-node'}, the src/config.js module object, and attrs.config into attrs.config and returns new WebexNode(attrs). Per-file behavior is in src/docs/README.md.

webex-core-plugin-host.summary: WebexCore.extend creates WebexNode; the WebexCore constructor normalizes credential attributes and its initialize merges the webex-core configuration (with registered plugin configuration) under attrs.config. Plugin registration, credentials, the service catalog, storage, and the request pipeline are owned and specified by @webex/webex-core.

webex-sdk-plugins.source: The 17 workspace plugin packages required by src/webex-node.js
webex-sdk-plugins.summary: Loaded for their registration side effects: @webex/plugin-authorization, @webex/internal-plugin-calendar, @webex/internal-plugin-device, @webex/internal-plugin-presence, @webex/internal-plugin-support, @webex/internal-plugin-llm, @webex/plugin-attachment-actions, @webex/plugin-device-manager, @webex/plugin-logger, @webex/plugin-messages, @webex/plugin-memberships, @webex/plugin-people, @webex/plugin-rooms, @webex/plugin-teams, @webex/plugin-team-memberships, @webex/plugin-webhooks, and @webex/plugin-encryption. Each package owns its registered name, API, and configuration.

artifact_decisions.reason: Library package, not a deployable service. package.json has no start script, container, or deployment descriptor.

The package serves no HTTP routes and sends no requests itself; its published surface is the npm export described by webex-node-sdk.
No package-level security policy exists. The workspace root SECURITY.md is not overwritten and a per-package copy would duplicate it.
Contribution instructions are owned at the workspace root and linked from this package README.md.
Changelog generation is owned at the workspace root. This package has no changelog file.
The CTO readiness checklist applies to deployable services. This package is a library.
